digest.component_or_area: op-cert service key provisioning and signing
propositions: Op-cert currently performs per-job boto3/SSM/region lookup and patches process-global state, coupling application config to one secret store and creating concurrency/cleanup hazards.

Startup must validate exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY before queue/worker/network/workspace creation, copy into process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file mode, and never reread except on restart.

Both producer chains (completion via sign_completion_verdict and plan-review via generation.sign_manifest) must accept and forward an optional context-local OpcertSigner binding that overrides os.environ key lookup.
Op-cert application runtime must have no SSM/boto3/region dependency; key must be materialized outside the app by fetch-secrets.sh before start and bind-mounted read-only with REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH.
Concurrent and timed-out jobs must demonstrate context-local signer/principal/push isolation with one immutable startup signer and no workspace push remote.
Secret/key material must not appear in repr, serialization, argv, logs, exceptions, output, fingerprints, provenance, children, or persisted envelopes beyond the existing public signature.
